verdict.rationale: Steel is cloud browser infrastructure that serves as a tool for external agents rather than an agent that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is the wrong axis for this product type. The evidence that Steel exposes its browser as MCP tools to MCP clients (steel-docs-9, steel-docs-46) shows the server role and belongs to a different story. Nothing in the pack shows Steel itself connecting to third-party MCP servers.
